A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the heart rate of the monkey is not a good predictor of avoidance response rates.
the heart rate response to avoidance training is a function of the amount of shock received, the amount of shock expected, the number of avoidance responses made and the amount of shock avoided.
the Rhesus monkeys used in our experiments are not capable of learning to avoid the shock stimulus.
